correctness.rationale: For the fixed 3-path with ordered a0<=c0<=b0 and d=b0-a0>0, pure neighborhood confidence has center-to-leaf directed distances zero and leaf-to-center distances |b-a|/2; hence both leaves open or close together. Strict gate epsilon<=d/2 permanently freezes leaves; the center follows c_next=(1-rho)c+rho*A with independent fair endpoints, giving unique contracting Bernoulli convolution, mean midpoint and variance rho*d^2/[4(2-rho)], no almost-sure pointwise limit, and SLLN time average. rho=1/2 yields uniform binary expansion. For epsilon>d/2, symmetric simultaneous compromise with rho<=1/2 preserves ordered endpoints, contracts their gap and holds gates open. Conserved average and exact V contraction with spectral bound E V_t <=(1-rho*(1-rho))^t V0 imply almost-sure consensus via summability. Exact strict equality boundary checked. Independent rational history check verified 3072 length-seven edge histories and exact finite recursion moments; infinite time assertions use coupling, SLLN and Borel-Cantelli, not enumeration.
residual_risks: Only ordered center-between-leaves initial state and rho<=1/2; outside these hypotheses order preservation is unproved

originality.rationale: The stationary random affine-recursion mechanism including uniform binary series and variance has an exact predecessor: Acemoğlu et al Section 2.1, one regular node and two exogenously stubborn neighbors. Do not claim these formulas standalone as novel. The assessed NDW statement adds the endogenous confidence threshold that causes precisely this stubborn configuration, plus a disjoint all-responsive consensus regime for exactly the same input and model, in a uniform if-and-only-if phase classification. The primary NDW model paper simulates the general model but its inspected technical setup and conclusions do not present this exact three-path theorem.
residual_risks: All frozen-branch stationary formulae and nonconvergence after reduction are strongly covered by Acemoğlu et al; originality only holds for the endogenous necessary-and-sufficient gating and consensus counterpart.
Model convention sigma=0 and direction of d(i,j) are crucial; another convention could change the phase boundary.
Other three-agent bounded-confidence classifications may have been published under different notation.
